scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic. No finite computation is used to infer an infinite-dimensional statement. The only imported nonstandard lemma is Proposition 3.11 of arXiv:2311.03064, whose hypotheses were checked in the full text.

title: Arbitrary-index \(\ell_p\)-sums of Daugavet spaces have exactly one SCD point
